No wallet app on this device

Seed Vault, Phantom or Solflare isn\'t installed. You can use the built-in devnet wallet instead: a key is created on this device and stored encrypted (Android Keystore), then filled with free devnet test SOL. Mints and buys are real devnet transactions you can check in Solana Explorer. Devnet SOL has no real value.
